Software Engineer.description: Designs, builds and maintains software systems.
learning_areas: Complete a Python OOP course
Practice LeetCode data structures
Build a REST API project
Learn Git branching and pull requests

Data Scientist.description: Extracts insights from data using statistical analysis and machine learning techniques.
learning_areas: Complete a statistics and probability course
Build end-to-end ML projects with scikit-learn
Practice exploratory data analysis on Kaggle datasets
Learn data storytelling with Matplotlib and Seaborn
Study feature engineering and model evaluation techniques

Data Analyst.description: Interprets data sets to identify trends and communicate actionable business insights.
learning_areas: Master SQL joins, window functions and aggregations
Learn Tableau or Power BI for dashboard creation
Practice data cleaning with Python and Pandas
Take a business analytics or statistics course
Build a portfolio of reports from public datasets

Frontend Developer.description: Builds and maintains the visual and interactive components of web applications.
learning_areas: Complete a modern JavaScript (ES6+) course
Build projects with React including hooks and state management
Learn CSS Flexbox, Grid and responsive design patterns
Practice consuming REST APIs from the frontend
Study web accessibility and performance optimisation

Backend Developer.description: Designs and implements server-side logic, databases and APIs that power applications.
learning_areas: Build a production-ready REST API with FastAPI or Django REST Framework
Learn relational database design and query optimisation
Study authentication patterns such as JWT and OAuth2
Practice containerising applications with Docker
Learn basic CI/CD pipeline setup

UX Designer.description: Researches user needs and designs intuitive, accessible digital experiences.
learning_areas: Complete a UX design fundamentals course such as Google UX Design Certificate
Build a case-study portfolio with Figma prototypes
Learn how to conduct usability tests and document findings
Study WCAG accessibility guidelines
Practice designing and iterating based on user feedback

DevOps Engineer.description: Automates infrastructure, deployments and monitoring to enable reliable and fast software delivery.
learning_areas: Learn Docker and Kubernetes for container orchestration
Set up a CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions or Jenkins
Study Infrastructure as Code with Terraform
Practice cloud deployments on AWS, GCP or Azure
Learn observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana
Explore site reliability engineering (SRE) principles

Machine Learning Engineer.description: Develops, deploys and maintains scalable machine learning models and pipelines in production.
learning_areas: Build and deploy an end-to-end ML pipeline
Learn MLOps tools such as MLflow or Weights and Biases
Study deep learning with PyTorch or TensorFlow
Practice model optimisation, quantisation and serving
Learn containerisation and cloud deployment of ML models
Explore A/B testing and model monitoring in production
